# Vaia

> > Vaia is the #1 learning app for university and school students, offering AI-powered study tools, spaced repetition flashcards, and comprehensive educational content across multiple disciplines.

Vaia provides expert-verified explanations created by educators from institutions like Durham University, covering subjects from biology and business studies to archaeology and art history. The platform features AI learning tools, exam preparation resources, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition
- AI Learning
- Flashcards
- Exam Preparation
- Educational Content
- Biology
- Business Studies
- Art History
- Archaeology
- Durham University
- Student Tools
- Study Platform
- Gene Expression
- Corporate Finance
- Urban Studies

## Getting Started

- [Vaia | The #1 learning app for university & school](https://www.vaia.com/en-us): Homepage for Vaia learning app with AI tools and spaced repetition
- [Discover U.S. Degrees, Majors, Universities & Colleges](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/degrees): Comprehensive database of U.S. degrees, majors, and university programs

## Biology & Life Sciences

- [Control of Gene Expression: Combinatorial & Factors](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/biology/control-of-gene-expression): Gene expression control in prokaryotes with transcription factors
- [Ecology: Definition, Examples & Theories | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/biology/ecology): Ecology fundamentals covering succession, niche, and human ecology theories
- [Energy Transfers in Biology: Types, Diagram & Formula](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/biology/energy-transfers): Biological energy transfer types, equations, and conversion diagrams
- [Organ Systems: Definition, Examples & Diagram | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/biology/organ-systems): Human organ systems anatomy, functions, and physiology diagrams

## Business & Finance

- [Business Operations: Meaning, Examples & Types | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/business-studies/business-operations): Business operations management fundamentals with practical examples
- [Corporate Finance: Examples & Fundamentals | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/business-studies/corporate-finance): Corporate finance fundamentals, restructuring, and investment banking
- [Nature of Business: Definition and Explanation | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/business-studies/nature-of-business): Business fundamentals covering strategy, planning, and business models
- [Strategic Direction: Definition and Example | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/business-studies/strategic-direction): Strategic direction planning, methods, and business strategy matrix

## Arts, Architecture & Design

- [Art Movements: Expressionism, Surrealism | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/art-and-design/art-movements): Art movements guide covering Expressionism, Surrealism, Dada, and Cubism
- [Fine Arts: Definition, Techniques & History | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/art-and-design/fine-arts): Fine arts definition, techniques, history, and museum examples
- [Urban Studies in Architecture: Techniques & Themes](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/architecture/urban-studies-in-architecture): Urban studies principles, techniques, and architectural theory overview

## Archaeology & Anthropology

- [Archaeological Techniques: Methods & Tools | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/archaeology/archaeological-techniques): Archaeological excavation methods, tools, and scientific techniques guide
- [Dating and Chronology: Key Dating Techniques](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/archaeology/dating-and-chronology): Archaeological dating techniques and chronology methods explained
- [Political Anthropology: Theory & Examples | Vaia](https://www.vaia.com/en-us/explanations/anthropology/political-anthropology): Political anthropology theory, definitions, and examples by Durham experts
